item.name: furniture
item.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Paint ONE consistent six-object furniture atlas for a moonlit BOOK-WORLD classroom, same beautiful gouache material as the supplied warm-hall furniture but cool navy/mulberry book leather and moon-blue shadows. EXACT3columns x2rows of equal512x512 cells on a1536x1024 pure solid#FF00FF canvas. Each cell has ONE whole separate object, generous margins, no objects crossing cells. All six are frontal orthographic platform-game objects with perfectly horizontal level walkable top and a continuous straight broad lower base across at least90%of object width. No perspective V bases, no detached shadows, no thin dangling feet. Top-left cream-gold light, dark ink contours, textured gouache, readable broad page edges, gentle worn gold book corners, no words/letters/numbers. ROW1 LEFT: one large OPEN FOLIO laid nearly flat, broad cream pages with shallow central crease, level horizontal upper silhouette, navy covers, wide continuous bottom. ROW1 MIDDLE: one CLOSED DICTIONARY, single thick book, deep navy covers and cream page block, rectangular level top/bottom, slight burgundy ribbon at side only. ROW1 RIGHT: upright compact THREE-book BUNDLE, horizontal large navy/wine/olive folios stacked under one central brown leather strap, flat top and full-width bottom, width:height about1.2:1. ROW2 LEFT: LOW READING LECTERN, wide level walnut top board, narrow angled reading insert contained below the level full-width top silhouette, ONE short turned wooden pedestal, broad continuous rectangular base at least90%top width, overallwidth:height1.2:1. ROW2 MIDDLE: LOW NIGHT BOOKSHELF, walnut rectangle framing four broad horizontal folios, flat bright full-width top board and flat solid full-width base, overall2:1. ROW2 RIGHT: TEACHER'S LECTERN-SHELF: broad low solid book-filled shelf with a small upright book on a reading stand centered ABOVE it; small upper stand less40%totalwidth, fullwidth horizontal walkable deck exposed at both sides at about40%of objectheight; solid broad base, overallwidth:height1.5:1. Every item clearly distinct; hand-painted complete objects, no copied atlas cells, no tiling, no characters or scenery. Strong clean solid magenta separation, no fuzzy alpha or pink reflections.
